headline: <wan-device> reloaded at 15:40:12Z (Reload Command, from console); its <wan-interface> went down then up at 15:41Z and BGP to <edge-device> (<neighbor-address>) is Up again after a Down at 15:40Z. <operator> committed config on <edge-device> from <source-ip> at 15:55Z. 9 devices logged; 41 board rows unchanged.
